senses.gloss:
Bappa
father of Bappabhaṭṭi Sūri (a. of Caturvim3śatijinastuti, BORI. 1149 of 1887-91. BORI. D. XIX. I. i. 146).

Bappabhaṭṭi
ins. poet. See C. I. I. IV. p. 142.

Bappabhaṭṭisūri
alias Bhadrakīrti (743-838 A. D.); son of Bappa an. Bhaṭṭi; author of 52 works; for his biographical details see Prabhāvakacarita (XI) of Prabhācandra Sūri an. Caturvim3śatiprabandha (IX) of Rājaśekhara.
--Anubhūtasiddhasarasvatīstotra or Śāradāstotra in 13 verses.
Pt.. See NCC. I. Revised edn. p.. 207b-208a.
--Caturvim3śatijinastuti.
Pt.. See NCC. VI. p. 324b. Verses from this are found in Stutisaṅgraha, Bombay, 1912.

Bappabhaṭṭisūrikathā
or Bappahaṭṭisūrikahā. Jain. Pkt. life of Bappabhaṭṭi an. King Amā.
America 5422. BORI. 165 of 1872-73. BORI. D. XIX. II. ii. 433. D. p. 50. Gough p. 111.
--diff. in 685 Pkt. gāthās. Pattan I. p. 195.

Bappabhaṭṭisūricaritra
Jain. Baroda II. 2192. BBRAS. 1757. BORI. 297 of Ā883-84. 1304 of 1884-87. 776 of 1892-95. BORI. D. XIX. II. ii. 434. 435. D. p. 414. Peters. II. p. 200 (no. 297) (inc.). V. p. 292 (no. 776). [Page233-a.
On its relation to the early history of the Gurjara empire see JBBRAS. III. i & ii.

Bappabhaṭṭistuti
Jainagranthāvalī p. 284.
--C. ibid.

Bāpaṇṇa(nna)bhaṭṭa
See Boppaṇṇa(na) Bhaṭṭa below.

Bāpadevīśrāddhaprakaraṇa
dh. Mandlik p. 79. BN. 22 (fr. Śaka 1720).
Is it Āpadevīº ?.

Bāpabhaṭi(bhavabhaṭṭa)
Bud.
--Śrīcakrasam3varapañjikā. Cordier II. p. 27.

Bāpirāja
of Alaśiṅgarāja family; resident of Kākaraparti village, near Elūr (Ellore) fortress on the banks of the river Vāsiṣṭha (a branch of the Godāvarī); grandfather of Brahma an. great-grandfather of Rāmeśvara (a. of Pañcāṅgasarali, MT. 2298).
--C. Vivṛti on Kālāmṛta. See NCC. IV. p. 45b.
Addl. ms.:
Mysore N. D. IX. 29661. Extr. p.. 36-37.

Bāpudīkṣita
--Jñānavallī. mantra. Kavīndrācārya 1162 (Skandha 5).

Bāpudeva
--C. on Vedastuti or Śrutiº from 10th Skandha of Bhāgavata. K. 30.

Bāpūdeva
teacher of Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa (a. of Kāśīrahasyaprakāśa, IO. 3702).

Bāpubhaṭṭa
alias Ananta Bhaṭṭa.
--Pratiṣṭhāpaddhati. dh. K. 184.

Bāpūbhaṭṭa
--Mūlyādhyāya or Mūlyasaṅgraha. dh. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 91. L. 4120 Mithilā I. 296.

Bāpūdīkṣitajaṭe
--Kuṇḍamaṇḍapavidhi. NP. V. 50. [Page259-b]

Bāpūdeva_śāstrin
--Golopapatti. jy. Mithilā.
--Cāpajātya. jy. ibid.
--Bhūbhramaṇa. jy. Mithilā III. 242.
--Vicitrapraśna. jy. Mithilā.
--Vicitrapraśnasaṅgraha. jy. ibid.
--Siddhāntavivekaparīkṣā. jy. ibid.

Bāpūdevajña
--C. Ṭippaṇa on Laghu(tithi)cintāmaṇi of Gaṇeśa Daivajña. SB. New D.. IX. 34762. Wai D. II. 9879. 9880.

Bāpū(bābū)bhaṭṭa_Kelakara
of Phaṇasigrāma; son of Mahādeva Kelakara. a Cittapāvana brahmin.
--Utsarjanopākarmaprayoga. Āśval. See NCC. II. p. 322a.
Addl. mss.:
ASB. I. ii. 163. Wai D. I. 3782.
--Kāṭhakāgniprayoga or ºcayana krama. See NCC. III. p. 303b.
Addl. ms.:
BISM. (Pt.. Cat.) 37/228 (Baudh.).
--Kṛtyamañjarī. composed in 1718 A. D. See NCC. IV. p. 277a.
Addl. ms.:
Wai D. I. 3048.
--Prāyaścittamañjarī. dh. See above p. 174a. [Page260-a.
--Śrāddhamañjari. dh. composed in 1810 A. D.
Pt.. Ānandāśrama 59. 1909.

Bāppacandra
Q. by Hemādri in his C. on Aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasam3hitā. See Śrāddhamayūkha, Bombay edn. 1927; mentioned by Śivadatta in C. on Śivakośa. See Poona Ori. VII. p. 67.
